findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed ice accumulation in the walk-in freezer (Freezer 1). This ice accumulation is contacting bagged vegetables stored on the top shelf in the walk-in. The head of maintenance was present during the inspection and stated that Henson Robinson has performed maintenance on the freezer in the last four weeks. There was thermal tape and insulation foam present on the leaking lines. It seems these fixes are inadequate to prevent leakage onto food and food contact surfaces. The staff were instructed to move the vegetables stored directly below the leaking lines to a dry location and keep a container under the lines to capture the water. Ensure food is stored in clean, dry locations at all times to prevent contamination. The freezer requires maintenance prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Mop basin was observed to be in need of resealing or re-caulking.  Areas subject to moisture must be non-absorbent and easily cleanable.  Ensure mop basin is re-caulked to prevent mold growth.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Walk-in cooler containing milk cartons was observed to contain an accumulation of dust on the cooler fans and grates.  Ensure fans and grates are cleaned regularly to prevent contamination of food items in the walk-in cooler.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
